passage.text: Nam and Emma are having dinner at a restaurant with food from Chiang Mai.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ənd ˈɛmə ər ˈhævɪŋ ˈdɪnər ət ə ˈrɛstərɑːnt wɪð ˈfuːd frəm ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

passage.text: The waiter brings them a small box of sticky rice.
passage.reading: ðə ˈweɪtər ˈbrɪŋz ðɛm ə ˈsmɔːl ˈbɑːks əv ˈstɪki ˈraɪs.

passage.text: "How do I eat this?" Emma says. "Do I use a spoon?"
passage.reading: ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈiːt ðɪs? ˈɛmə ˈsɛz. duː aɪ ˈjuːz ə ˈspuːn?

passage.text: "No. Eat it with your hand," Nam says.
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ. ˈiːt ɪt wɪð jʊr ˈhænd, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "Take a little rice with your fingers and make a small ball.
passage.reading: ˈteɪk ə ˈlɪtəl ˈraɪs wɪð jʊr ˈfɪŋɡərz ənd ˈmeɪk ə ˈsmɔːl ˈbɔːl.

passage.text: Then dip it in the sauce, like this."
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ˈdɪp ɪt ɪn ðə ˈsɔːs, ˈlaɪk ðɪs.
ˈɛmə ˈtraɪz ɪt. ˈwaʊ! ɪts dɪˈlɪʃəs!

passage.text: She dips her rice in every sauce on the table.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈdɪps hɜːr ˈraɪs ɪn ˈɛvri ˈsɔːs ɑːn ðə ˈteɪbəl.

passage.text: After twenty minutes, she says, "I'm so full!"
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts, ʃiː ˈsɛz, aɪm ˈsoʊ ˈfʊl!

passage.text: "Be careful. Sticky rice makes you full very quickly," Nam says.
passage.reading: bi ˈkɛrfəl. ˈstɪki ˈraɪs ˈmeɪks juː ˈfʊl ˈvɛri ˈkwɪkli, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "Now I know!" Emma says, and they both laugh.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈnoʊ! ˈɛmə ˈsɛz, ənd ðeɪ ˈboʊθ ˈlæf.
